title: FloraFare food_buffs file
description: A file in data/<namespace>/food_buffs/. Either an object with an 'entries' array, a single entry object, or (legacy) a bare array of entries. config_generation.json uses its own schema.

priority.description: File-wide priority, used by every entry that does not set its own. Higher wins when two tag entries both match an item.

_comment.description: Ignored by the loader — a note for whoever edits the file. Florafare's own tag_categories.json uses it.

id.description: What this entry targets: an item id (minecraft:bread), a tag (#c:foods/vegetable), a namespace (namespace:farmersdelight), the catch-all (template:default), or a journal-only potion row (potion:minecraft:strength).

duration.description: Buff duration in TICKS. 20 ticks = 1 second; 6000 = 5 minutes.

nutrition.description: Hunger points restored. Whole numbers only — 1 point = half a drumstick. Negative drains hunger.

saturation.description: Saturation MODIFIER, vanilla semantics: restored saturation = nutrition x saturation x 2. Does nothing when nutrition is 0.

health_bonus.description: Extra max health for the buff's duration. 2.0 = one heart. Removed when the buff ends.

priority.description: Overrides the file-wide priority for this entry.

always_edible.description: Lets the food be eaten at full hunger.

effects.description: Status effects applied when the food is eaten.

attributes.description: Attribute modifiers held for the buff's duration.

_comment.description: Ignored by the loader — a note for whoever edits the file. Florafare's own tag_categories.json uses it.

id.description: Status effect id. Must be registered, or the effect is skipped with an error in the log.

amplifier.description: Effect level minus one: 0 = level I.

_comment.description: Ignored by the loader — a note for whoever edits the file. Florafare's own tag_categories.json uses it.

attribute.description: Any registered entity attribute id, e.g. minecraft:generic.attack_damage.

operation.description: Anything else falls back to add_value.

_comment.description: Ignored by the loader — a note for whoever edits the file. Florafare's own tag_categories.json uses it.
